1.pickthall: By those that winnow with a winnowing
1.shakir: I swear by the wind that scatters far and wide,
1.muhammad_sarwar: By the winds which carry dust particles,

2.sahih_international: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
2.pickthall: And those that bear the burden (of the rain)
2.yusuf_ali: And those that lift and bear away heavy weights;
2.shakir: Then those clouds bearing the load (of minute things in space).
2.muhammad_sarwar: by the clouds which are heavily loaded with water,
2.mohsin_khan: And (the clouds) that bear heavy weight of water;

3.pickthall: And those that glide with ease (upon the sea)
3.yusuf_ali: And those that flow with ease and gentleness;
3.muhammad_sarwar: by the ships which smoothly sail on the oceans,
3.mohsin_khan: And (the ships) that float with ease and gentleness;

4.pickthall: And those who distribute (blessings) by command,
4.yusuf_ali: And those that distribute and apportion by Command;-
4.shakir: Then those (angels who) distribute blessings by Our command;
4.muhammad_sarwar: by the angels which distribute the affairs,
4.mohsin_khan: And those (angels) who distribute (provisions, rain, and other blessings) by (Allah's) Command;

5.sahih_international: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
5.pickthall: Lo! that wherewith ye are threatened is indeed true,
5.yusuf_ali: Verily that which ye are promised is true;
5.shakir: What you are threatened with is most surely true,
5.muhammad_sarwar: that what you are promised is certainly true
5.mohsin_khan: Verily, that which you are promised (i.e. Resurrection in the Hereafter and receiving the reward or punishment of good or bad deeds, etc.) is surely true.
5.arberry: surely that you are promised is true,

6.sahih_international: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
6.pickthall: And lo! the judgment will indeed befall.
6.yusuf_ali: And verily Judgment and Justice must indeed come to pass.
6.shakir: And the judgment must most surely come about.
6.muhammad_sarwar: and the Day of Judgment will inevitably take place.
6.mohsin_khan: And verily, the Recompense is sure to happen.
6.arberry: and surely the Doom is about to fall!

7.pickthall: By the heaven full of paths,
7.yusuf_ali: By the Sky with (its) numerous Paths,
7.shakir: I swear by the heaven full of ways.
7.mohsin_khan: By the heaven full of paths,
7.arberry: By heaven with all its tracks

8.sahih_international: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
8.pickthall: Lo! ye, forsooth, are of various opinion (concerning the truth).
8.yusuf_ali: Truly ye are in a doctrine discordant,
8.shakir: Most surely you are at variance with each other in what you say,
8.mohsin_khan: Certainly, you have different ideas (about Muhammad SAW and the Quran).

9.sahih_international: Deluded away from the Qur'an is he who is deluded.
9.pickthall: He is made to turn away from it who is (himself) averse.
9.yusuf_ali: Through which are deluded (away from the Truth) such as would be deluded.
9.shakir: He is turned away from it who would be turned away.
9.muhammad_sarwar: Let whoever wishes, turn away from Our Quran.
9.mohsin_khan: Turned aside therefrom (i.e. from Muhammad SAW and the Quran) is he who is turned aside (by the Decree and Preordainment of Allah).

10.muhammad_sarwar: Death to those whose opinions are merely baseless conjectures.

11.sahih_international: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
11.pickthall: Who are careless in an abyss!
11.yusuf_ali: Those who (flounder) heedless in a flood of confusion:
11.shakir: Who are in a gulf (of ignorance) neglectful;
11.muhammad_sarwar: and who wander in the abyss of confusion.
11.mohsin_khan: Who are under a cover of heedlessness (think not about the gravity of the Hereafter),

12.sahih_international: They ask, "When is the Day of Recompense?"
12.pickthall: They ask: When is the Day of Judgment?
12.yusuf_ali: They ask, "When will be the Day of Judgment and Justice?"
12.shakir: They ask: When is the day of judgment?
12.muhammad_sarwar: They ask, "When it will be the Day of Judgment?"
12.mohsin_khan: They ask; "When will be the Day of Recompense?"
12.arberry: asking, 'When shall be the Day of Doom?'

13.sahih_international: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
13.pickthall: (It is) the day when they will be tormented at the Fire,
13.yusuf_ali: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (and tested) over the Fire!
13.shakir: (It is) the day on which they shall be tried at the fire.
13.muhammad_sarwar: On the Day of Judgment they will be punished by the fire
13.mohsin_khan: (It will be) a Day when they will be tried (i.e. burnt) over the Fire!
13.arberry: Upon the day when they shall be tried at the Fire:

14.sahih_international: [And will be told], "Taste your torment. This is that for which you were impatient."
14.pickthall: (And it will be said unto them): Taste your torment (which ye inflicted). This is what ye sought to hasten.
14.yusuf_ali: "Taste ye your trial! This is what ye used to ask to be hastened!"
14.shakir: Taste your persecution! this is what you would hasten on.
14.muhammad_sarwar: and will be told, "Suffer the torment which you wanted to experience immediately".
14.mohsin_khan: "Taste you your trial (burning)! This is what you used to ask to be hastened!"
14.arberry: 'Taste your trial! This is that you were seeking to hasten.'

15.sahih_international: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
15.pickthall: Lo! those who keep from evil will dwell amid gardens and watersprings,
15.yusuf_ali: As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs,
15.shakir: Surely those who guard (against evil) shall be in gardens and fountains.
15.muhammad_sarwar: The pious ones will live amidst gardens and springs,
15.mohsin_khan: Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V. 2:2) will be in the midst of Gardens and Springs (in the Paradise),
15.arberry: Surely the godfearing shall be among gardens and fountains

16.sahih_international: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
16.pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
16.yusuf_ali: Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
16.shakir: Taking what their Lord gives them; surely they were before that, the doers of good.
16.muhammad_sarwar: receiving their reward from their Lord. They had been righteous people before the Day of Judgment.
16.mohsin_khan: Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinun (good-doers - see V. 2:112).
16.arberry: taking whatsoever their Lord has given them; they were good-doers before that.

17.sahih_international: They used to sleep but little of the night,
17.pickthall: They used to sleep but little of the night,
17.yusuf_ali: They were in the habit of sleeping but little by night,
17.shakir: They used to sleep but little in the night.
17.muhammad_sarwar: They slept very little during the night
17.mohsin_khan: They used to sleep but little by night [invoking their Lord (Allah) and praying, with fear and hope].
17.arberry: Little of the night would they slumber,

18.sahih_international: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
18.pickthall: And ere the dawning of each day would seek forgiveness,
18.yusuf_ali: And in the hour of early dawn, they (were found) praying for Forgiveness;
18.shakir: And in the morning they asked forgiveness.
18.muhammad_sarwar: and asked for forgiveness in the early morning.
18.mohsin_khan: And in the hours before dawn, they were (found) asking (Allah) for forgiveness,
18.arberry: and in the mornings they would ask for forgiveness;

19.sahih_international: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
19.pickthall: And in their wealth the beggar and the outcast had due share.
19.yusuf_ali: And in their wealth and possessions (was remembered) the right of the (needy,) him who asked, and him who (for some reason) was prevented (from asking).
19.shakir: And in their property was a portion due to him who begs and to him who is denied (good).
19.muhammad_sarwar: They assigned a share of their property for the needy and the destitute.
19.mohsin_khan: And in their properties there was the right of the beggar, and the Mahrum (the poor who does not ask the others).
19.arberry: and the beggar and the outcast had a share in their wealth.

20.sahih_international: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
20.pickthall: And in the earth are portents for those whose faith is sure.
20.yusuf_ali: On the earth are signs for those of assured Faith,
20.shakir: And in the earth there are signs for those who are sure,
20.muhammad_sarwar: In the earth there is evidence (of the Truth) for those who have strong faith.
20.mohsin_khan: And on the earth are signs for those who have Faith with certainty,
20.arberry: In the earth are signs for those having sure faith;

21.sahih_international: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
21.pickthall: And (also) in yourselves. Can ye then not see?
21.yusuf_ali: As also in your own selves: Will ye not then see?
21.shakir: And in your own souls (too); will you not then see?
21.muhammad_sarwar: There is also evidence of the Truth within your own selves. Will you then not see?
21.mohsin_khan: And also in your ownselves. Will you not then see?
21.arberry: and in your selves; what, do you not see?

22.sahih_international: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
22.pickthall: And in the heaven is your providence and that which ye are promised;
22.yusuf_ali: And in heaven is your Sustenance, as (also) that which ye are promised.
22.shakir: And in the heaven is your sustenance and what you are threatened with.
22.muhammad_sarwar: In the heavens there is your sustenance and that which you were promised (Paradise).
22.mohsin_khan: And in the heaven is your provision, and that which you are promised.
22.arberry: And in heaven is your provision, and that you are promised.

23.sahih_international: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
23.pickthall: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth, it is the truth, even as (it is true) that ye speak.
23.yusuf_ali: Then, by the Lord of heaven and earth, this is the very Truth, as much as the fact that ye can speak intelligently to each other.
23.shakir: And by the Lord of the heavens and the earth! it is most surely the truth, just as you do speak.
23.muhammad_sarwar: This, by the Lord of the heavens and the earth is as certain as your ability to speak.
23.mohsin_khan: Then, by the Lord of the heaven and the earth, it is the truth (i.e. what has been promised to you), just as it is the truth that you can speak.
23.arberry: So by the Lord of heaven and earth, it is as surely true as that you have speech.

24.sahih_international: Has there reached you the story of the honored guests of Abraham? -
24.pickthall: Hath the story of Abraham's honoured guests reached thee (O Muhammad)?
24.yusuf_ali: Has the story reached thee, of the honoured guests of Abraham?
24.shakir: Has there come to you information about the honored guests of Ibrahim?
24.muhammad_sarwar: Have you heard the story of the honorable guests of Abraham?
24.mohsin_khan: Has the story reached you, of the honoured guests [three angels; Jibrael (Gabriel) along with another two] of Ibrahim (Abraham)?
24.arberry: Hast thou received the story of the honoured guests of Abraham?

25.sahih_international: When they entered upon him and said, "[We greet you with] peace." He answered, "[And upon you] peace, [you are] a people unknown.
25.pickthall: When they came in unto him and said: Peace! he answered, Peace! (and thought): Folk unknown (to me).
25.yusuf_ali: Behold, they entered his presence, and said: "Peace!" He said, "Peace!" (and thought, "These seem) unusual people."
25.shakir: When they entered upon him, they said: Peace. Peace, said he, a strange people.
25.muhammad_sarwar: When they came to him saying, "Peace be with you," he replied to their greeting in the same manner and said to himself, "These are a strange people".
25.mohsin_khan: When they came in to him, and said, "Salam, (peace be upon you)!" He answered; "Salam, (peace be upon you)," and said: "You are a people unknown to me,"
25.arberry: When they entered unto him, saying 'Peace!' he said 'Peace! You are a people unknown to me.'

26.sahih_international: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
26.pickthall: Then he went apart unto his housefolk so that they brought a fatted calf;
26.yusuf_ali: Then he turned quickly to his household, brought out a fatted calf,
26.shakir: Then he turned aside to his family secretly and brought a fat (roasted) calf,
26.muhammad_sarwar: He went quietly to his wife and returned to his guests with a fat, roasted calf.
26.mohsin_khan: Then he turned to his household, so brought out a roasted calf [as the property of Ibrahim (Abraham) was mainly cows].
26.arberry: Then he turned to his household and brought a fattened calf,

27.sahih_international: And placed it near them; he said, "Will you not eat?"
27.pickthall: And he set it before them, saying: Will ye not eat?
27.yusuf_ali: And placed it before them.. he said, "Will ye not eat?"
27.shakir: So he brought it near them. He said: What! will you not eat?
27.muhammad_sarwar: He placed it before them. Then he said, "Why are you not eating?"
27.mohsin_khan: And placed it before them, (saying): "Will you not eat?"
27.arberry: and he laid it before them saying, 'Will you not eat?'

28.sahih_international: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
28.pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
28.yusuf_ali: (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
28.shakir: So he conceived in his mind a fear on account of them. They said: Fear not. And they gave him the good news of a boy possessing knowledge.
28.muhammad_sarwar: He began to feel afraid. They said, "Do not be afraid," and then gave him the glad news of the birth of a knowledgeable son.
28.mohsin_khan: Then he conceived a fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of an intelligent son, having knowledge (about Allah and His religion of True Monotheism).
28.arberry: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said, 'Be not afraid!' And they gave him good tidings of a cunning boy.

29.sahih_international: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, "[I am] a barren old woman!"
29.pickthall: Then his wife came forward, making moan, and smote her face, and cried: A barren old woman!
29.yusuf_ali: But his wife came forward (laughing) aloud: she smote her forehead and said: "A barren old woman!"
29.shakir: Then his wife came up in great grief, and she struck her face and said: An old barren woman!
29.muhammad_sarwar: His wife came forward, crying and beating her face, saying, "I am an old barren woman!"
29.mohsin_khan: Then his wife came forward with a loud voice, she smote her face, and said: "A barren old woman!"
29.arberry: Then came forward his wife, clamouring, and she smote her face, and said, 'An old woman, barren!'

30.sahih_international: They said, "Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing."
30.pickthall: They said: Even so saith thy Lord. Lo! He is the Wise, the Knower.
30.yusuf_ali: They said, "Even so has thy Lord spoken: and He is full of Wisdom and Knowledge."
30.shakir: They said: Thus says your Lord: Surely He is the Wise, the Knowing.
30.muhammad_sarwar: They said, "This is true but your Lord has said, (that you will have a son); He is All-wise and All-knowing".
30.mohsin_khan: They said: "Even so says your Lord. Verily, He is the All-Wise, the All-Knower."
30.arberry: They said, 'So says thy Lord; He is the All-wise, the All-knowing.'

31.sahih_international: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"
31.pickthall: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
31.yusuf_ali: (Abraham) said: "And what, O ye Messengers, is your errand (now)?"
31.shakir: He said: What is your affair then, O apostles!
31.muhammad_sarwar: Abraham asked, "Messengers, what is your task?"
31.mohsin_khan: [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "Then for what purpose you have come, O Messengers?"
31.arberry: Said he, 'And what is your business, envoys?'

32.sahih_international: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
32.pickthall: They said: Lo! we are sent unto a guilty folk,
32.yusuf_ali: They said, "We have been sent to a people (deep) in sin;-
32.shakir: They said: Surely we are sent to a guilty people,
32.muhammad_sarwar: They replied, "We have been sent to a sinful people
32.mohsin_khan: They said: "We have been sent to a people who are Mujrimun (polytheists, sinners, criminals, disbelievers in Allah);
32.arberry: They said, 'We have been sent to a people of sinners,

33.sahih_international: To send down upon them stones of clay,
33.pickthall: That we may send upon them stones of clay,
33.yusuf_ali: "To bring on, on them, (a shower of) stones of clay (brimstone),
33.shakir: That we may send down upon them stone of clay,
33.muhammad_sarwar: to bring down upon them showers of marked lumps of clayy.
33.mohsin_khan: To send down upon them stones of baked clay.
33.arberry: to loose upon them stones of clay

34.sahih_international: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors."
34.pickthall: Marked by thy Lord for (the destruction of) the wanton.
34.yusuf_ali: "Marked as from thy Lord for those who trespass beyond bounds."
34.shakir: Sent forth from your Lord for the extravagant.
34.muhammad_sarwar: They are transgressors in the presence of your Lord".
34.mohsin_khan: Marked by your Lord for the Musrifun (polytheists, criminals, sinners those who trespass Allah's set limits in evil-doings by committing great sins).
34.arberry: marked with thy Lord for the prodigal.

35.sahih_international: So We brought out whoever was in the cities of the believers.
35.pickthall: Then we brought forth such believers as were there.
35.yusuf_ali: Then We evacuated those of the Believers who were there,
35.shakir: Then We brought forth such as were therein of the believers.
35.muhammad_sarwar: We saved the believers among them,
35.mohsin_khan: So We brought out from therein the believers.
35.arberry: So We brought forth such believers as were in it,

36.sahih_international: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
36.pickthall: But We found there but one house of those surrendered (to Allah).
36.yusuf_ali: But We found not there any just (Muslim) persons except in one house:
36.shakir: But We did not find therein save a (single) house of those who submitted (the Muslims).
36.muhammad_sarwar: but We found only one Muslim house.
36.mohsin_khan: But We found not there any household of the Muslims except one [i.e. Lout (Lot) and his two daughters].
36.arberry: but We found not therein except one house of those that have surrendered themselves.

37.sahih_international: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
37.pickthall: And We left behind therein a portent for those who fear a painful doom.
37.yusuf_ali: And We left there a Sign for such as fear the Grievous Penalty.
37.shakir: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
37.muhammad_sarwar: We left therein evidence for those who fear the painful torment.
37.mohsin_khan: And We have left there a sign (i.e. the place of the Dead Sea, well-known in Palestine) for those who fear the painful torment.
37.arberry: And therein We left a sign to those who fear the painful chastisement.

38.sahih_international: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
38.pickthall: And in Moses (too, there is a portent) when We sent him unto Pharaoh with clear warrant,
38.yusuf_ali: And in Moses (was another Sign): Behold, We sent him to Pharaoh, with authority manifest.
38.shakir: And in Musa: When We sent him to Firon with clear authority.
38.muhammad_sarwar: There is also evidence (of the Truth) in the story of Moses when We sent him to the Pharaoh with clear authority.
38.mohsin_khan: And in Musa (Moses) (too, there is a sign). When We sent him to Fir'aun (Pharaoh) with a manifest authority.
38.arberry: And also in Moses, when We sent him unto Pharaoh, with a clear authority,

39.sahih_international: But he turned away with his supporters and said," A magician or a madman."
39.pickthall: But he withdrew (confiding) in his might, and said: A wizard or a madman.
39.yusuf_ali: But (Pharaoh) turned back with his Chiefs, and said, "A sorcerer, or one possessed!"
39.shakir: But he turned away with his forces and said: A magician or a mad man.
39.muhammad_sarwar: The Pharaoh and his forces turned away from him, saying, "He is either a magician or an insane person".
39.mohsin_khan: But [Fir'aun (Pharaoh)] turned away (from Belief in might) along with his hosts, and said: "A sorcerer, or a madman."
39.arberry: but he turned his back, with his court, saying, 'A sorcerer, or a man possessed!'

40.sahih_international: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
40.pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
40.yusuf_ali: So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
40.shakir: So We seized him and his hosts and hurled them into the sea and he was blamable.
40.muhammad_sarwar: We seized him and his army and threw them into the sea. He himself was to be blamed.
40.mohsin_khan: So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, while he was to be blamed.
40.arberry: So We seized him and his hosts, and We cast them into the sea, and he blameworthy.

41.sahih_international: And in 'Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
41.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) A'ad (there is a portent) when we sent the fatal wind against them.
41.yusuf_ali: And in the 'Ad (people) (was another Sign): Behold, We sent against them the devastating Wind:
41.shakir: And in Ad: When We sent upon them the destructive wind.
41.muhammad_sarwar: There is also evidence of the Truth in the story of Ad whom We struck with a violent wind
41.mohsin_khan: And in 'Ad (there is also a sign) when We sent against them the barren wind;
41.arberry: And also in Ad, when We loosed against them the withering wind

42.sahih_international: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
42.pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
42.yusuf_ali: It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
42.shakir: It did not leave aught on which it blew, but it made it like ashes.
42.muhammad_sarwar: which turned everything it approached into dust.
42.mohsin_khan: It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.
42.arberry: that left nothing it came upon, but made it as stuff decayed.

43.sahih_international: And in Thamud, when it was said to them, "Enjoy yourselves for a time."
43.pickthall: And in (the tribe of) Thamud (there is a portent) when it was told them: Take your ease awhile.
43.yusuf_ali: And in the Thamud (was another Sign): Behold, they were told, "Enjoy (your brief day) for a little while!"
43.shakir: And in Samood: When it was said to them: Enjoy yourselves for a while.
43.muhammad_sarwar: There is also evidence (of the Truth) in the story of the Thamud, who were told to enjoy themselves for an appointed time.
43.mohsin_khan: And in Thamud (there is also a sign), when they were told: "Enjoy yourselves for a while!"
43.arberry: And also in Thamood, when it was said to them, 'Take your enjoyment for a while!'

44.sahih_international: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
44.pickthall: But they rebelled against their Lord's decree, and so the thunderbolt overtook them even while they gazed;
44.yusuf_ali: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord: So the stunning noise (of an earthquake) seized them, even while they were looking on.
44.shakir: But they revolted against the commandment of their Lord, so the rumbling overtook them while they saw.
44.muhammad_sarwar: They transgressed against the command of their Lord. So a blast of sound struck them and they were unable to do anything but stare.
44.mohsin_khan: But they insolently defied the Command of their Lord, so the Sa'iqah overtook them while they were looking.
44.arberry: Then they turned in disdain from the commandment of their Lord, and the thunderbolt took them and they themselves beholding

45.sahih_international: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
45.pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
45.yusuf_ali: Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
45.shakir: So they were not able to rise up, nor could they defend themselves-
45.muhammad_sarwar: They were unable to stand up, nor were they helped.
45.mohsin_khan: Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
45.arberry: and they were not able to stand upright, and were not helped.

46.sahih_international: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
46.pickthall: And the folk of Noah aforetime. Lo! they were licentious folk.
46.yusuf_ali: So were the People of Noah before them for they wickedly transgressed.
46.shakir: And the people of Nuh before, surely they were a transgressing people.
46.muhammad_sarwar: The people of Noah who lived before them were also evil doing people.
46.mohsin_khan: (So were) the people of Nuh (Noah) before them. Verily, they were a people who were Fasiqun (rebellious, disobedient to Allah).
46.arberry: And the people of Noah before; surely they were an ungodly people.

47.sahih_international: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
47.pickthall: We have built the heaven with might, and We it is Who make the vast extent (thereof).
47.yusuf_ali: With power and skill did We construct the Firmament: for it is We Who create the vastness of pace.
47.shakir: And the heaven, We raised it high with power, and most surely We are the makers of things ample.
47.muhammad_sarwar: We have made the heavens with Our own hands and We expanded it.
47.mohsin_khan: With power did We construct the heaven. Verily, We are Able to extend the vastness of space thereof.
47.arberry: And heaven -- We built it with might, and We extend it wide.

48.sahih_international: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
48.pickthall: And the earth have We laid out, how gracious is the Spreader (thereof)!
48.yusuf_ali: And We have spread out the (spacious) earth: How excellently We do spread out!
48.shakir: And the earth, We have made it a wide extent; how well have We then spread (it) out.
48.muhammad_sarwar: We have spread out the earth and how brilliantly it is spread!
48.mohsin_khan: And We have spread out the earth, how Excellent Spreader (thereof) are We!
48.arberry: And the earth -- We spread it forth; O excellent Smoothers!

49.sahih_international: And of all things We created two mates; perhaps you will remember.
49.pickthall: And all things We have created by pairs, that haply ye may reflect.
49.yusuf_ali: And of every thing We have created pairs: That ye may receive instruction.
49.shakir: And of everything We have created pairs that you may be mindful.
49.muhammad_sarwar: We have created everything in pairs so that perhaps you may take heed.
49.mohsin_khan: And of everything We have created pairs, that you may remember (the Grace of Allah).
49.arberry: And of everything created We two kinds; haply you will remember.

50.sahih_international: So flee to Allah. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
50.pickthall: Therefor flee unto Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from him.
50.yusuf_ali: Hasten ye then (at once) to Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
50.shakir: Therefore fly to Allah, surely I am a plain warner to you from Him.
50.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), tell them,"Seek refuge in God. I have been sent from Him to plainly warn you.
50.mohsin_khan: So flee to Allah (from His Torment to His Mercy Islamic Monotheism), verily, I (Muhammad SAW) am a plain warner to you from Him.
50.arberry: Therefore flee unto God! I am a clear warner from Him to you.

51.sahih_international: And do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
51.pickthall: And set not any other god along with Allah; lo! I am a plain warner unto you from Him.
51.yusuf_ali: And make not another an object of worship with Allah: I am from Him a Warner to you, clear and open!
51.shakir: And do not set up with Allah another god: surely I am a plain warner to you from Him.
51.muhammad_sarwar: Do not choose other gods besides Him. I have been sent from Him to plainly warn you".
51.mohsin_khan: And set not up (or worship) any other ilahan (god) along with Allah [Glorified be He (Alone), Exalted above all that they associate as partners with Him]. Verily, I (Muhammad SAW) am a plain warner to you from Him.
51.arberry: And set not up with God another god; I am a clear warner from Him to you.

52.sahih_international: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
52.pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
52.yusuf_ali: Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
52.shakir: Thus there did not come to those before them an apostle but they said: A magician or a mad man.
52.muhammad_sarwar: In the same way no Messenger came to those who lived before them without his people calling him a magician or an insane person.
52.mohsin_khan: Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them, but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"
52.arberry: Even so not a Messenger came to those before them but they said, 'A sorcerer, or a man possessed!'

53.sahih_international: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
53.pickthall: Have they handed down (the saying) as an heirloom one unto another? Nay, but they are froward folk.
53.yusuf_ali: Is this the legacy they have transmitted, one to another? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds!
53.shakir: Have they charged each other with this? Nay! they are an inordinate people.
53.muhammad_sarwar: Have they inherited such dealings with the Prophets from their predecessors or are they a rebellious people?
53.mohsin_khan: Have they (the people of the past) transmitted this saying to these (Quraish pagans)? Nay, they are themselves a people transgressing beyond bounds (in disbelief)!
53.arberry: What, have they bequeathed it one to another? Nay, but they are an insolent people.

54.sahih_international: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
54.pickthall: So withdraw from them (O Muhammad), for thou art in no wise blameworthy,
54.yusuf_ali: So turn away from them: not thine is the blame.
54.shakir: Then turn your back upon them for you are not to blame;
54.muhammad_sarwar: (Muhammad), leave them alone and you will not be blamed.
54.mohsin_khan: So turn away (O Muhammad SAW) from them (Quraish pagans) you are not to be blamed (as you have conveyed Allah's Message).
54.arberry: So turn thou from them; thou wilt not be reproached.

55.sahih_international: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
55.pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
55.yusuf_ali: But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
55.shakir: And continue to remind, for surely the reminder profits the believers.
55.muhammad_sarwar: Keep on reminding them. This benefits the believers.
55.mohsin_khan: And remind (by preaching the Quran, O Muhammad SAW) for verily, the reminding profits the believers.
55.arberry: And remind; the Reminder profits the believers.

56.sahih_international: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
56.pickthall: I created the jinn and humankind only that they might worship Me.
56.yusuf_ali: I have only created Jinns and men, that they may serve Me.
56.shakir: And I have not created the jinn and the men except that they should serve Me.
56.muhammad_sarwar: We have created jinn and human beings only that they might worship Me.
56.mohsin_khan: And I (Allah) created not the jinns and humans except they should worship Me (Alone).
56.arberry: I have not created jinn and mankind except to serve Me.

57.sahih_international: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
57.pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
57.yusuf_ali: No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
57.shakir: I do not desire from them any sustenance and I do not desire that they should feed Me.
57.muhammad_sarwar: I do not expect to receive any sustenance from them or that they should feed Me.
57.mohsin_khan: I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).
57.arberry: I desire of them no provision, neither do I desire that they should feed Me.

58.sahih_international: Indeed, it is Allah who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
58.pickthall: Lo! Allah! He it is that giveth livelihood, the Lord of unbreakable might.
58.yusuf_ali: For Allah is He Who gives (all) Sustenance,- Lord of Power,- Steadfast (for ever).
58.shakir: Surely Allah is the Bestower of sustenance, the Lord of Power, the Strong.
58.muhammad_sarwar: It is God Who is the Sustainer and the Lord of invincible strength.
58.mohsin_khan: Verily, Allah is the All-Provider, Owner of Power, the Most Strong.
58.arberry: Surely God is the All-provider, the Possessor of Strength, the Ever-Sure.

59.sahih_international: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
59.pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
59.yusuf_ali: For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
59.shakir: So surely those who are unjust shall have a portion like the portion of their companions, therefore let them not ask Me to hasten on.
59.muhammad_sarwar: The unjust will bear a burden like that of their unjust predecessors. Let them not make Me bring immediate punishment upon them.
59.mohsin_khan: And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old), so let them not ask Me to hasten on!
59.arberry: The evildoers shall have their portion, like the portion of their fellows; so let them not hasten Me!

60.sahih_international: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
60.pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
60.yusuf_ali: Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
60.shakir: Therefore woe to those who disbelieve because of their day which they are threatened with.
60.muhammad_sarwar: Woe to the disbelievers when the day with which they have been threatened comes!
60.mohsin_khan: Then, woe to those who disbelieve (in Allah and His Oneness Islamic Monotheism) from (that) their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).
60.arberry: So woe to the unbelievers, for that day of theirs that they are promised.
